made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/cruce-sheet-make.js, from cruce-set.html (window.CRUCE.E) and the design of El cruce (the orchestrator's p5-spec, section cruce). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 96, OY = H / 2 + originY = 118. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the streets are turned 45 degrees: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the crossing's middle at (0, 0); the set's E.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 96 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 118 + 13 v - 22.5 z. Half a street's width is E.HW = 1.25; the picture holds u from -3.69 to 5.54 and, on the ground, v from -9.08 to 7.54
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the ground; z .46: the seat's top; z .9 and .8: on a sprite; z .55: the low wall's top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere. People walk on the roadway in this scene (there are no cars): no spot is kept off the street
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty), 41 for a child; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30, drawn rows 0 to 49; abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; a child or a grown-up sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 7 a child: 33; t 11 a grown-up: 41) on (sx, sy); kneeling (papa_rodillas): the sitting drawing with its feet on the spot (stand-in); Canelo lying mkPerro('lie') (30 x 22): column 15 and its bottom edge; the bebé mkBebe (26 x 28): column 13 and its bottom edge (a stand-in: it is a sitting baby; mamá holds him up, z .9); a small thing: its bottom middle on the point
rules.view: a view has a zoom (here 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture) and x0 = clamp(round(sx - 98), 0, 44), sx the middle of the columns of the spots the view must hold. Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.box: a place of the frog (the six of story 59) is a poke box 24 x 20: its bottom middle on the spot, so [sx - 12, sy - 20, 24, 20]

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the hedges, the trees' crowns and trunks, the seat and the walls hide whoever is behind them.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as El mostrador's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn (the frog on the handlebar ties with Luis exactly: z .9 lifts him by the same depth as his place on the picture)

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El mostrador's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28) and .3 for the dog (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on the seat, stands on its back or on the wall (z above 0) casts none: the seat is not ground (a shadow cast at the pavement under it would show in front of it)
